item: row 367: Living sources follows a language switch
summary: Seven app-living.js renderers held through ooLive/ooLiveHtml: every loading and failure line of the Living views (the stream, a diff, the Law changes and the evolution panels, the pages, the maps, the point-in-time and topic searches with their prompts, the cross-edition compare), the overview's failure line and a diff's Show/Hide button. The cached-view repaint of the cross-edition compare no longer blanks a loading or failure line it has no answer for. No open PR touched app-living.js. Driven as real code, 28 mutations all caught.
